items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production inventory OBJECT PNG for Joseon Hunters, a dark Korean Joseon-fantasy isometric ARPG. Primary request: make one isolated SATGAT (삿갓), the humble Korean wanderer's wide conical woven-straw hat. Subject: low broad cone, pointed peak, entire brim, worn muted wheat-brown hemp/straw weave in broad readable bands, a thin tied dark-russet chin cord attached to the hat. Three-quarter view, slightly tilted to reveal the conical shape. Preserve a clear pointed cone so it differs from the already approved round-crowned paeraengi hat. Style/medium: match the approved D1 independent-object inventory presentation seen in the conversation: premium hand-painted material illustration, thin restrained ink contour, matte broad value planes, dark warm weathered palette, sparse material-specific highlights, large simple forms. One soft upper-left light, no rim light or bloom. Composition: ONE complete centered cutout, no wearer/head, no second hat, no scenery. Generous 8% safe transparent margin. Readable within a 2x2 inventory footprint shown at only 80x80 game pixels; final packed file will be160x160, keep the cone and weave legible without busy fine noise. Background: actual fully transparent alpha. Do not bake a floor shadow, slot, rectangle, board, frame, label, letters, logo or watermark. No witch hat, Western fantasy armor, Japanese samurai clothing, glossy plastic, glow, loose unrelated props. This is a NEW object asset, not a catalog sheet or a UI screenshot.

Keep simple large panels and only a few structural stitches; no noisy microtexture. One soft warm upper-left light, weak ambient fill, sparse small bronze highlights, no bloom or white rim outline. Composition: one centered complete three-quarter-view helmet, angled slightly to show front and side, safe transparent margin8%. Actual fully transparent alpha background, no ground/cast-shadow floor, frame, square slot, title, letters or watermark. Intended footprint2x2 cells, shown80x80px in game, final160x160. Material silhouette must survive small display. Avoid Western medieval plate helmet, nasal face guard, Viking horns, samurai crest, Chinese imperial ornament, sculpted skull, face, extra equipment, glossy plastics, decorative magic effects. Generate a NEW production asset, not a sheet.
